about.heroSub: We help students in Kazakhstan find their first job faster, and companies find the best candidates effortlessly.
about.missionText: Bridge the gap between education and the job market in Kazakhstan. Students shouldn't spend months searching — AI does it in minutes, matching positions to their profile and ambitions.
about.feature1Desc: Gemini analyzes your profile — skills, major, experience — and finds internships with the highest match score.
about.feature2Desc: One click — a personalized cover letter tailored to a specific vacancy based on your profile.
about.feature3Desc: Track the status of every application in real time and receive Telegram notifications.
about.projectText1: Work&Study is a graduation project by students of Astana IT University (AITU). The platform was built to solve a real problem: it's hard for Kazakhstani students to find their first internship, and for employers to quickly select the right candidates.
about.projectText2: Under the hood: Node.js, React, PostgreSQL, Prisma, Google Gemini AI. The interface supports Russian, Kazakh, and English.
